connected.emptyBody: Your Microsoft 365 mailbox and calendar appear here once you connect them: offers go out from your own mailbox and appointments land in your calendar. Connecting becomes available with the Outlook integration.

connected.conflict: This connection was changed in the meantime or is already disconnected.
